name: Sakura Sumihito
source:
He is a contractor who works in the condominium. He is a friendly but reserved person who is trusted for his careful work.

In his private life, however, he has a “side job” such as online distribution, which is almost illegal.

Rina, who is close to him in age, treats him like a friend and junior colleague, and he is an easy person to talk to.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/ntr_mansion/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
